mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia which increases the risk of chloroquine-induced cardiac arrhythmias; chloroquine may also impair chlorthalidone's antihypertensive efficacy through fluid retention.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; maintain electrolyte supplementation if needed; perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring; consider alternative antihypertensive if chloroquine therapy is essential.
